OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BADUNG REGENCY
NUMBER 15 YEAR 2013
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

2.5.rationale: In the Indonesian source, Pasal 15 is about “Pembinaan dan Pengawasan” (guidance/coaching and supervision) by the Bupati, including issuing implementation instructions, supervision, monitoring, and evaluation. This is oversight/administrative guidance, not explicit “training and capacity building” (pelatihan/peningkatan kapasitas) for implementers. The retrieved English passages accurately reflect Pasal 15, but the judge over-interpreted general guidance/supervision as capacity-building/training, producing a false positive.

4.1.evaluator_rationale: The candidate sentences state objectives to prevent violence and outline protection/services, plus community duties to prevent and report violence, but they do not specify information, awareness, communication, or education activities aimed at preventing violence against women.
